proposals.title: Method Flow deadline-envelope, composite-probe decomposition, and partial-output evidence-credit ledger
proposals.mission_surface: command deadline, startup latency, composite probe, partial output, child completion, evidence credit, retry decomposition, and append-only failure retention
proposals.hypothesis: A method ledger can make deadline consumption and child completion explicit, refuse credit for silent or partial composite probes, and require a bounded decomposed witness before promotion.
proposals.null_or_failure: A timeout is treated as success, partial output is promoted without component completion, a retry silently widens the deadline, failed probes are erased, or decomposition crosses a protected gate.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Synthetic probe traces must retain failure and recovery witnesses, account for every deadline, reject partial-output promotion, and stop unbounded retries.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Withdraw unsupported evidence credit, retain the timed-out trace, split only read-only components, and restore the last clean owner-scoped state.
proposals.novelty_against_370_frozen_proposals: Earlier Method Flow work covers failure signatures, child starts, recurrence clusters, environment drift, causal graphs, and rollback budgets; none centers deadline accounting plus composite-probe decomposition and partial-output credit refusal.

proposals.title: GMUT Ward-identity, functional-measure Jacobian, and anomaly-accounting obligation tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: typed classical and quantum Ward identities, diffeomorphism and Weyl variation, functional measure, regulator declaration, Jacobian, anomaly coefficient, counterterm, power counting, and claim boundary
proposals.hypothesis: A symbolic obligation checker can distinguish classical identities from quantum measure effects and require declared field content, regulator, Jacobian, anomaly, and counterterm assumptions without claiming a complete quantum theory.
proposals.null_or_failure: A classical identity is promoted to an all-orders quantum result, a measure Jacobian is omitted, anomaly cancellation is asserted without field content, a regulator or counterterm changes the symmetry silently, or a formal fixture becomes empirical truth.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Positive and negative symbolic fixtures must type the identity level, variation, field content, measure, regulator, anomaly, counterterm, scale, and nonpromotion boundary.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the unsupported identity, restore explicit assumptions and order, retain the counterexample, and make no force, stability, likelihood, constraint, empirical, proof, or Theory-of-Everything claim.
proposals.novelty_against_370_frozen_proposals: The frozen chain covers Noether identities and currents, gauge fixing, frame maps, renormalization, eikonal transport, and operator bases; none makes functional-measure Jacobians and anomaly accounting the central scalar-tensor obligation surface.

proposals.title: GMUT Gaia DR3 wide-binary selection, multiplicity-contamination, and covariance-aware zero-row protocol
proposals.mission_surface: Gaia DR3 provenance, astrometric covariance, pair selection, chance alignment, unresolved multiples, radial-velocity availability, selection blinding, nuisance model, likelihood reservation, and zero-row stop
proposals.hypothesis: A zero-row public-data contract can enumerate provenance, covariance, selection, contamination, nuisance, blinding, and likelihood requirements without downloading observations or producing a GMUT result.
proposals.null_or_failure: The phase ingests a real row, ignores covariance or unresolved companions, tunes selection after seeing an outcome, treats competing analyses as independent confirmation, evaluates a likelihood, or reports a force or constraint.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: The phase must retain zero downloaded rows, zero likelihood evaluations, and zero constraints; real execution requires frozen selection, covariance and contamination models, source-independent review, and a separately authorized analysis.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop before download or fit, retain the zero-row receipt, and route any real study through a new preregistration, appropriate data handling, statistical review, and independent scientific scrutiny.
proposals.novelty_against_370_frozen_proposals: Earlier empirical proposals cover waves, pulsars, lensing, ranging, ephemerides, BAO, EHT, SLR, and sirens; no frozen title centers Gaia wide-binary covariance, unresolved-multiple contamination, and outcome-blind selection.

proposals.title: THOS digital-preservation ingest-team fixity-exception, rights-escalation, and shift-handover matched-budget protocol
proposals.mission_surface: digital preservation ingest, fixity exception, rights uncertainty, dual review, escalation, shift handover, matched budget, workload, blinding, harm monitoring, and staff reservation
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic schedule can represent matched-budget ingest-team handovers and fixity or rights exception escalation while exposing workload and authority-gradient risks.
proposals.null_or_failure: A fixture uses real staff, donors, patrons, or collections; decides a rights question; rewards bypassing preservation controls; breaks matched budgets or blinding; omits workload or harm monitoring; or claims THOS effectiveness.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Synthetic vectors may pass, but THOS remains represented until preregistered blind matched-budget real arms, authorized participants and institutions, safety and workload monitoring, appropriate statistics, and independent review exist.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the proxy schedule and failures, void promoted comparisons, and require qualified preservation, workplace, ethics, statistics, rights, and affected-party processes outside the repository.
proposals.novelty_against_370_frozen_proposals: Prior THOS proposals cover clinical, aviation, maritime, maintenance, alarm, learning, fatigue, and generic handover designs; none centers digital-preservation fixity exceptions and rights escalation under matched budgets.

proposals.title: Freed ID OpenID4VCI batch-issuance atomicity, proof-array, and partial-failure profile
proposals.mission_surface: batch-size metadata, credential configuration or identifier exclusivity, proof arrays, audience and nonce binding, response cardinality, encryption policy, notification semantics, partial failure, minimization, and nonproduction
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic OpenID4VCI profile can reject over-limit, mixed-identifier, unbound, stale, cardinality-mismatched, partially accepted, or overbroad batch issuance without asserting real keys or interoperability.
proposals.null_or_failure: A vector accepts an unsupported batch, mixed identifier modes, an empty or oversized proof array, missing audience or nonce, response cardinality drift, a partial storage failure as overall success, real secrets, or production assurance wording.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Synthetic vectors must enforce advertised batch size, identifier exclusivity, proof-array shape, freshness and audience binding, response and notification semantics, encryption policy, privacy boundaries, and full-flow failure on partial storage error.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the synthetic transaction, retain the vector, disclose no real key or holder data, and restore the strictest supported single-credential or atomic batch policy.
proposals.novelty_against_370_frozen_proposals: Earlier Freed ID proposals cover offers, proof of possession, deferred issuance, attestations, DCQL, status, federation, migration, and presentation binding; none centers final OpenID4VCI batch-size, proof-array, and partial-failure semantics.

proposals.title: CBR community-archive embargo, takedown, donor-versus-collective consent, and Maori-authority reservation matrix
proposals.mission_surface: community archive access, embargo and takedown, donor agreement, collective interests, sacred or restricted knowledge, provenance, privacy, remedy, legal interpretation, affected parties, and Maori authority
proposals.hypothesis: A refusal-first matrix can expose unresolved access, takedown, consent, provenance, remedy, and authority questions without deciding a real collection case or appropriating Maori concepts or authority.
proposals.null_or_failure: The matrix names a real donor or community member, overrides collective authority with an individual agreement, publishes restricted material, decides copyright or tikanga, prescribes remedy, asserts Maori authority, or treats a repository record as enacted law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Only authorized affected communities, rights holders, donors where relevant, archival institutions, privacy and legal authorities, tangata whenua, iwi, hapu, and Maori authorities can close their respective gates; repository software must stop at unknown or reserved.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop before access or remedy conclusions, preserve refusals and unknowns, minimize data, and route only through authorized affected-party, legal, institutional, cultural, and Maori processes outside the repository.
proposals.novelty_against_370_frozen_proposals: Earlier CBR proposals cover museums, repatriation, protected disclosure, cadastral records, litigation holds, remedy funds, fisheries, and data stewardship; none centers community-archive embargo and takedown conflicts between donor and collective authority.

proposals.title: Python checked-hash bytecode, import-path shadowing, and cache-origin replay tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: PEP 552 invalidation mode, source hash, bytecode cache header, import origin, sys.path precedence, module cache, shadowing, isolated fixture, deterministic replay, and nonsecurity boundary
proposals.hypothesis: A disposable standard-library tribunal can verify checked-hash invalidation and expose source, bytecode, import-path, and module-cache origin drift without touching installed packages.
proposals.null_or_failure: Timestamp or unchecked bytecode receives deterministic credit, a shadow module wins silently, sys.modules hides a changed origin, a fixture writes outside its temporary root, or bounded replay is called exhaustive security.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Disposable fixtures must cover checked-hash pass, stale-source refusal, unchecked-hash noncredit, path shadowing, cache-origin drift, and cleanup, using only the standard library and an owner-local temporary root.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Discard only the disposable fixture, clear only fixture-owned module-cache keys, retain the failure receipt, and keep supply-chain, production, and exhaustive-security claims false.
proposals.novelty_against_370_frozen_proposals: Prior tooling proposals cover archives, parsers, Git object formats, environment parity, and path confinement; none centers PEP 552 checked-hash bytecode together with import-path shadowing and module-cache origin replay.

proposals.title: Native modal-dialog top-layer, inert-background, and focus-return structural audit

proposals.title: Maxwell-relation mixed-partial symmetry, Legendre-domain, and psyche-reciprocity nonconversion classifier

proposals.title: Stage 20 holdout-contamination, adaptive-reuse, and oracle-disclosure nonpromotion board

proposals.hypothesis: A fail-closed board can quarantine Stage 20 evidence credit when a holdout is disclosed, adaptively reused, or queried beyond a preregistered budget.

boundary: Software, official or primary sources, and synthetic fixtures establish bounded structural behavior only. They do not establish empirical GMUT confirmation, a detected force, a unique prediction, a likelihood or constraint, THOS effectiveness, professional competence, production identity assurance, CBR legitimacy, legal or cultural ratification, Maori authority, independent-team reproduction, AGI or ASI, consciousness or personhood, complete accessibility, exhaustive security, a Theory of Everything, deployment approval, proof or canon, or Stage 20 readiness.
